0.name: TEXT_REGSEAREDISTRIBUTION_00087_JNASSHYM_000_1
0.description: You <hex:021A020203>have<hex:021A020103> heard of the Brugaire Consortium, I trust? We are one of the largest merchant outfitters in the entire city<hex:021F0103>state of Limsa Lominsa, and deal in an extensive range of wares including weapons, perishables, and fashionable apparel.

1.name: TEXT_REGSEAREDISTRIBUTION_00087_JNASSHYM_000_2
1.description: I have but recently been appointed chief assistant to Vice-chairman Bango Zango. Ah, brokering deals and negotiating trade contracts...it is my calling in life.

4.name: TEXT_REGSEAREDISTRIBUTION_00087_A1_000_2
4.description: Can I have another pair of shoes?

6.name: TEXT_REGSEAREDISTRIBUTION_00087_JNASSHYM_000_10
6.description: What's this? Are you struggling to tell me you have <hex:021A020203>lost<hex:021A020103> the fine pair of shoes I chose <hex:021A020203>especially<hex:021A020103> for you?

7.name: TEXT_REGSEAREDISTRIBUTION_00087_JNASSHYM_000_11
7.description: Fortunately, I have another such pair available. You may have them out of the kindness of my heart...and the loathing in my soul I bear for your usual “attire.”
